articles.summaryTr: Bulls Yatırım Menkul Değerler, 13 Kasım'da vadesi dolan 982 milyon lira nominal değerli finansman bonosunun anapara ve kupon ödemesini gerçekleştiremediğini KAP'a bildirdi. Şirket, ödemelerin faaliyetlerinin geçici olarak durdurulması nedeniyle yapılamadığını açıkladı.
articles.articleText: Bulls Yatırım, 982 milyon liralık bono ödemesini gerçekleştiremedi - Bulls Yatırım Menkul Değerler, 13 Kasım'da vadesi dolan 982 milyon lira nominal değerli finansman bonosunun anapara ve kupon ödemesini gerçekleştiremediğini KAP'a bildirdi. Şirket, ödemelerin faaliyetlerinin geçici olarak durdurulması nedeniyle yapılamadığını açıkladı. Bulls Yatırım Menkul Değerler AŞ, 982 milyon lira nominal değerli finansman bonosunun vadesi gelen anapara ve kupon ödemesini gerçekleştiremediğini duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirket tarafından Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformunda (KAP) yapılan açıklamada, 22 Mayıs 2026 tarihinde ihraç edilen TRFBLLYK2610 ISIN kodlu finansman bonosunun vadesinin 13 Kasım 2026 olduğu belirtildi. Toplam 982 milyon lira nominal değerli, 175 gün vadeli finansman bonosunun yıllık basit faiz oranının yüzde 42,75, yıllık bileşik faiz oranının ise yüzde 47,53 olduğu bildirildi. Açıklamada, Sermaye Piyasası Kurulunun (SPK) fon tasfiyesine ilişkin 17 Eylül 2026 tarihli kararlarıyla başlayan süreç sonrasında, Kurulun 20 Ekim 2026 tarihli ve 73/1875 sayılı kararıyla şirketin faaliyetlerinin 21 Ekim 2026 tarihinde geçici olarak durdurulduğu hatırlatıldı. Bu süreç nedeniyle finansman bonosunun anapara ve kupon ödemesinin gerçekleştirilemediği kaydedildi. KAP bildiriminde, 13 Kasım 2026 tarihinde yapılması gereken kupon ve anapara ödemelerinin gerçekleştirilmediği bilgisi paylaşıldı.

articles.summaryTr: Chicago Fed Başkanı Austan Goolsbee, ABD'de enflasyonun geniş tabanlı şekilde yanlış yönde ilerlediğini belirterek, Fed'in enflasyonla mücadelede halen yapacak işi olduğunu söyledi. Goolsbee, yapay zeka yatırımlarının da fiyatları yukarı çektiğine dikkat çekti.
articles.articleText: Fed üyesi Goolsbee'den kritik uyarı: Enflasyon yanlış yönde ilerliyor - Chicago Fed Başkanı Austan Goolsbee, ABD'de enflasyonun geniş tabanlı şekilde yanlış yönde ilerlediğini belirterek, Fed'in enflasyonla mücadelede halen yapacak işi olduğunu söyledi. Goolsbee, yapay zeka yatırımlarının da fiyatları yukarı çektiğine dikkat çekti. CNBC'ye konuşan ABD Merkez Bankası (Fed) üyesi Austan Goolsbee, enflasyon, istihdam piyasası ve yapay zeka yatırımlarının ekonomiye etkilerine ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulundu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Enflasyonun yalnızca enerji fiyatlarından kaynaklanmadığını belirten Goolsbee, fiyat artışlarının enerji kaynaklı yükselişlerin görülmediği kategorilere de yayıldığını ifade etti. Goolsbee, "Fed'in enflasyon konusunda halen yapacak işi olduğu fikrine katılıyorum" dedi. Yapay zeka yatırımları fiyatları yukarı çekiyor Yapay zeka altyapısına yönelik yatırımların ekonomideki etkilerine de değinen Goolsbee, bu yatırımların enerji maliyetlerine ek olarak ekonomideki ısınmayı artırdığını söyledi. Veri merkezi yatırımlarının fiyatları yukarı çektiğini belirten Goolsbee, "Talep aşırı ısınıyorsa enflasyonu göz ardı edemeyiz" ifadelerini kullandı. İstihdam piyasası istikrarlı ABD'de istihdam piyasasının istikrarlı olduğunu belirten Goolsbee, iş gücü piyasasının bir miktar sıkı olarak da nitelendirilebileceğini söyledi. Ücret enflasyonu görülmemesini rahatlatıcı bulmadığını ifade eden Goolsbee, ücretlerin enflasyon açısından gecikmeli bir gösterge olduğunu vurguladı. articles.titleTr: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
articles.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, Jane Street increased its share count in Fidelity’s spot Bitcoin ETF nearly eightfold in the third quarter, US President Donald Trump nominated four new SEC and CFTC commissioners, including a replacement for prominent crypto advocate Hester Peirce and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang abruptly resigned. Jane Street boosts Fidelity Bitcoin ETF holdings nearly 8x, trims IBIT Jane Street’s share count in Fidelity’s spot Bitcoin exchange-traded fund (ETF) rose nearly eightfold in the third quarter, while its holdings in BlackRock’s fund fell 19%. The trading giant ended September with 7.01 million shares of Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC0, up from about 887,000 at the end of June. The position was worth $509 million on Sept. 30, according to its second-quarter and third-quarter filings. Jane Street’s holdings in BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT) fell to 20.22 million shares from 24.88 million. A higher share price lifted the reported value of its stake to $957 million from $828 million. Jane Street was the largest reported institutional holder of BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF at the end of June after boosting its share count by 324% in Q2, according to 13F Pro. IBIT is the world’s largest spot Bitcoin ETF with $56 billion in net assets as of Thursday. The firm also added nearly 9 million shares (about $249 million) of the ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF (ARKB), while more than doubling its holdings in BlackRock’s iShares Ethereum Trust ETF (ETHA) by 7.83 million shares (about $158 million). Trump nominates Hester Peirce successor among SEC, CFTC picks US President Donald Trump has nominated Steven Levine to replace former Securities and Exchange Commission Commissioner Hester Peirce, one of the agency’s most prominent crypto advocates, as part of four nominations to fill vacancies at the SEC and Commodity Futures Trading Commission. The White House’s latest announcement on Thursday named two nominees each for the SEC and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, agencies whose decisions help shape US cryptocurrency regulation, among other functions. All four nominations require Senate confirmation. The nominations would replenish several commissioner roles. The SEC currently has only two of its five commissioner seats filled, while CFTC Chairman Michael Selig is the sole member of his agency’s five-seat commission. The nominations come weeks before Democrats are set to take control of the Senate in January, giving a narrow window for Republicans to confirm Trump’s picks. Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, exits board; shares plunge Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as president and CEO and stepped down from the company’s board on Thursday, effective immediately. The board named Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress interim CEO. Kress will retain her role as CFO while Nvidia’s board considers internal and external candidates for the permanent CEO role. The board also appointed Harvey C. Jones its first chair and said it expects Nvidia’s operations to proceed without interruption. Nvidia shares fell more than 13% shortly after the US market opened on Thursday, trading at $151.00 as of 2:31 p.m. UTC, according to Yahoo Finance. Bitcoin (BTC) fell alongside Nvidia shares, dropping as much as 3.5% to a multimonth low. The shares later pared losses to trade at $165 at 4:24 p.m. UTC, down 5% on the day. The stock was down more than 26% over the previous month.

articles.summary: ABD Hazine Bakanı Scott Bessent, bakanlığının ve diğer bakanlıkların uzun zamandır Megaspeed’e kısıtlamalar getirilmesini desteklediğini, ancak yetkinin Ticaret Bakanlığında olduğunu söyledi.

articles.titleTr: Trump yönetiminde Nvidia anlaşmazlığı: Megaspeed krizi büyüyor
articles.summaryTr: ABD Hazine Bakanı Scott Bessent, bakanlığının ve diğer bakanlıkların uzun zamandır Megaspeed’e kısıtlamalar getirilmesini desteklediğini, ancak yetkinin Ticaret Bakanlığında olduğunu söyledi.
articles.articleText: Trump yönetiminde Nvidia anlaşmazlığı: Megaspeed krizi büyüyor - ABD Hazine Bakanı Scott Bessent, bakanlığının ve diğer bakanlıkların uzun zamandır Megaspeed’e kısıtlamalar getirilmesini desteklediğini, ancak yetkinin Ticaret Bakanlığında olduğunu söyledi. ABD Hazine Bakanı Scott Bessent, Trump yönetiminin Nvidia'nın gelişmiş yapay zeka çiplerinin Çin'e ulaşmasını engellemeye yönelik politikaları kapsamında Megaspeed şirketine kısıtlama getirilmesini uzun süredir desteklediklerini açıkladı. Bessent, konuyla ilgili yetkinin Ticaret Bakanlığı'nda olduğunu belirtirken, açıklamaları Trump yönetimi içinde ihracat kontrollerine ilişkin görüş ayrılıkları yaşandığı yönündeki iddiaları yeniden gündeme taşıdı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle CNBC'nin "Squawk Box" programında konuşan Bessent, Hazine, Savunma ve Dışişleri Bakanlıkları ile ABD Ticaret Temsilciliği Ofisi'nin Megaspeed'in kara listeye alınmasından aylardır yana olduğunu söyledi. Bessent, Ticaret Bakanlığı'nın tutumuna ilişkin ise "İç süreçleri hakkında onlara sormanız gerekecek" ifadelerini kullandı. Axios'tan Trump yönetiminde anlaşmazlık iddiası Bessent'in açıklamaları, Axios'un Trump yönetiminde Megaspeed'e yönelik ihracat kısıtlamaları konusunda anlaşmazlık yaşandığına ilişkin haberinin ardından geldi. Axios'un haberine göre Bessent, geçen hafta Beyaz Saray Durum Odası'nda Ticaret Bakanı Howard Lutnick'e, özellikle Megaspeed'e yönelik ihracat kontrollerinin uygulanmasına neden karşı çıktığını sordu. Haberde ayrıca Lutnick'in, Nvidia'nın gelişmiş yapay zeka çiplerini Çin'e yönlendirdiğinden şüphelenilen şirketlere yönelik önlemlerin alınmasını defalarca engellediği öne sürüldü. Ancak ABD Ticaret Bakanlığı söz konusu iddiayı yalanladı. Bakanlık Sözcüsü Kristen Eichamer, CNBC'ye yaptığı açıklamada Bessent ve Lutnick arasında Durum Odası'nda böyle bir konuşmanın gerçekleşmediğini belirtti. CNBC yayınında iddiaların sorulması üzerine Bessent ise "Durum Odası'nda yapılan konuşmaları tekrar etmiyoruz" yanıtını verdi. Bessent'ten Çin'e çip ihracatı açıklaması İhracat kontrollerindeki olası gecikmelerden dolayı hayal kırıklığı yaşayıp yaşamadığı sorulan Bessent, ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın Çin'in Nvidia'nın H100 modelinden daha gelişmiş çiplerine erişmemesi gerektiğini açıkça ortaya koyduğunu söyledi. Bessent, "Bu nedenle herhangi bir sızıntı çok sinir bozucu. Çünkü yapay zeka yarışındaki büyük şirketlerimize zarar veriyor ve Çinlilere avantaj sağlıyor" dedi.

articles.title: Arthur Hayes ‘flattered’ as Coinbase backs US stock perps
articles.summary: Arthur Hayes said he was “flattered” by Coinbase’s defense of US stock perpetual futures, a decade after BitMEX launched perpetual swaps.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Arthur Hayes ‘flattered’ as Coinbase backs US stock perps
articles.summaryTr: Arthur Hayes said he was “flattered” by Coinbase’s defense of US stock perpetual futures, a decade after BitMEX launched perpetual swaps.
articles.articleText: Arthur Hayes ‘flattered’ as Coinbase backs US stock perps Arthur Hayes said he was “flattered” by Coinbase’s defense of US stock perpetual futures, a decade after BitMEX launched perpetual swaps. Arthur Hayes, co-founder of BitMEX, said he was “flattered” by Coinbase’s support for the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) in a US legal dispute over stock perpetual futures. “When we launched the perpetual swap at BitMEX in 2016, Washington’s reaction was less than warm,” Hayes told Cointelegraph. “Ten years later, Coinbase is in federal court defending the right to offer them on US stocks. I’m flattered. Imitation is the sincerest form of regulation.” Coinbase and five other companies submitted a brief on Monday opposing the alliance’s request to block trading in perpetual futures tied to individual stocks. The court accepted the brief on Tuesday. The Capital Markets Alliance Association (CMAA), which brought the lawsuit, says the contracts should be treated as security-based swaps, which face tighter restrictions on retail trading. Hayes was CEO of BitMEX when the crypto derivatives exchange launched its Bitcoin perpetual swap, which let traders take leveraged positions on Bitcoin without a fixed expiration date. The product helped make perpetual swaps a staple of crypto trading. SEC weighs in on stock perpetuals The US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) reportedly submitted a proposed court brief on Monday, opposing the alliance’s request to temporarily halt trading in the contracts. The agency said it was reviewing the exchanges’ rules for listing the contracts. The brief left open whether the SEC would set those rules aside and whether the contracts qualify as security futures or security-based swaps. Related: EU DeFi proposals could push users to riskier platforms, says Coinbase exec In a Tuesday court filing, CMAA said that the CFTC had approved the contracts without adequately explaining its decision or addressing unresolved regulatory questions. The group also cited about $375 million in reported 24-hour notional trading volume for Kalshi’s stock perpetuals shortly after launch, claiming the products were already diverting business from traditional stock markets. Stock perpetuals’ lack of expiry is at issue Stock perpetuals let traders speculate on individual share prices without owning the underlying stocks. Unlike traditional futures, the contracts have no fixed expiration date. On Nov. 3, US District Judge Valerie Caproni denied the group’s request for a temporary restraining order because it had yet to show likely irreparable harm. She found the alliance was likely to succeed on its claim that the CFTC exceeded its authority. Wojciech Kaszycki, strategy adviser to BTCS SA, said the lack of a fixed expiration or delivery date could complicate the case for treating perpetual contracts as futures. Kaszycki told Cointelegraph that the case “sale for future delivery.” However, he warned that a ruling against the CFTC could push trading activity toward offshore and decentralized platforms. “The product doesn’t die; it just changes address,” he said. articles.title: Nakamoto shares fall 6% premarket after Q3 revenue turns negative
articles.summary: A $5.8 million loss on Bitcoin options pushed operating revenue below zero, and higher Bitcoin prices lifted net income to $85.5 million.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Nakamoto shares fall 6% premarket after Q3 revenue turns negative
articles.summaryTr: A $5.8 million loss on Bitcoin options pushed operating revenue below zero, and higher Bitcoin prices lifted net income to $85.5 million.
articles.articleText: Nakamoto shares fall 6% premarket after Q3 revenue turns negative A $5.8 million loss on Bitcoin options pushed operating revenue below zero, and higher Bitcoin prices lifted net income to $85.5 million. Shares in Nasdaq-listed Bitcoin treasury company Nakamoto fell 6.5% in premarket trading on Friday after the company reported that losses on Bitcoin options pushed third-quarter operating revenue below zero. Nakamoto’s shares traded at $5.40 at 12:02 pm UTC on Friday, according to Yahoo Finance. At that price, the stock was down about 62% year to date. Nakamoto reported its third-quarter results after the market closed on Thursday. The company generated $3.9 million in revenue from its businesses. A $5.8 million net loss on Bitcoin options brought total operating revenue to negative $1.9 million, according to its quarterly filing. Analysts had expected about $17.4 million in revenue, according to estimates compiled by Yahoo Finance. Nakamoto reported $85.5 million in net income and a $15.8 million adjusted operating loss for the quarter. A $110.4 million gain from revaluing its digital assets, chiefly Bitcoin (BTC), drove the profit. The adjusted operating loss excludes that gain. Nakamoto held 4,283 BTC worth $357.9 million as of Sept. 30, down from 4,467 BTC at the end of June. Related: Nakamoto taps Bitwise and Kraken for Bitcoin options strategy to hedge risk

articles.articleText: UN watchdog 'increasingly concerned' over uninspected Iran nuclear site - Published The UN's nuclear watchdog has said it is "increasingly concerned" about a nuclear facility in Iran which it has not been allowed to inspect. Iran informed the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) of plans to set up the uranium enrichment plant in the city of Isfahan a day before Israel began attacking its nuclear sites last June. The US joined the strikes later that month. In a report seen by news agencies, the IAEA said it does not know the exact location or whether it contains nuclear material. Since the start of the latest war, Iran has restricted IAEA inspectors' access to its nuclear sites, preventing the agency from verifying its enriched uranium stockpile. Under a 2015 nuclear deal, Iran agreed to limit its enriched uranium stockpile to 300kg and enrichment to 3.67% purity. It subsequently exceeded both. Before the June 2025 strikes, it had accumulated an estimated 441kg enriched to 60%, close to weapons grade. The nuclear complex at Isfahan suffered extensive damage in US and Israeli strikes, particularly the parts above the ground. The condition of its underground facilities is not clear. The IAEA believes much of Iran's highly enriched uranium was stored there. "The Agency's lack of information about [Iran's] nuclear material and access to facilities to verify it is a matter of serious proliferation concern... and needs to be rectified with the utmost urgency," it said in the latest report. Iran announced plans for the Isfahan Fuel Enrichment Plant (IFEP) on 12 June 2025, shortly after an IAEA resolution which declared Iran had failed to meet its nuclear safeguards obligations. Iran initially agreed to allow inspectors to visit the facility, but the inspection was cancelled after Israel launched attacks the following day. The IAEA's latest calls come almost a year after it made a similar appeal to Iran. At the time it said it had only inspected some of the 13 nuclear facilities that were "unaffected" by the attacks and none of the seven that were. The US and Israel said they attacked Iran's nuclear sites to prevent it developing nuclear weapons - something Iran has consistently denied seeking. It says its nuclear programme is for peaceful civilian purposes only. - Published7 days ago - Published5 days ago - Published23 June 2025

articles.title: How a sex scandal at Nvidia is putting pressure on the White House
articles.summary: Jensen Huang's personal life may have triggered the crisis, but the questions now reach into the White House itself.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: How a sex scandal at Nvidia is putting pressure on the White House
articles.summaryTr: Jensen Huang's personal life may have triggered the crisis, but the questions now reach into the White House itself.
articles.articleText: How a sex scandal at Nvidia is putting pressure on the White House - Published How close is Donald Trump to Jensen Huang? The answer is very. The Nvidia boss was one of the few business leaders with direct access to the US president. He had met Trump repeatedly, travelled with him to Britain and, in May, joined him on Air Force One for his trip to China. Jensen Huang wasn't just another tech billionaire seeking the president's ear. He had become an important voice in one of the biggest arguments inside the administration: how much of America's most advanced technology should be allowed to reach China. Nvidia makes the chips that power the AI revolution. Washington has restricted exports of its most advanced processors to China since 2022, believing they could help Beijing develop its military and technological capabilities. But enforcing those restrictions is difficult. Chips can be bought legally by customers in countries such as Singapore and Malaysia and then diverted to China. Chinese companies can also rent access to computing power through data centres outside the country. Jensen Huang has long argued that the restrictions are counterproductive. They shut Nvidia out of a huge market and encourage Chinese companies to develop their own alternatives. Trump appeared sympathetic to this view, allowing Nvidia to resume sales of certain chips to China last year in return for a share of the revenue, although its most advanced Blackwell chips remain off limits. But that relationship now looks rather more complicated. The allegations surrounding Jensen Huang's reported affair with Alice Huang, of no relation but a former executive at Singapore-based company Megaspeed, have raised the possibility that a foreign intelligence operation was targeting not just a powerful businessman, but someone with unusually close access to the American president. US intelligence reportedly suspects Alice Huang of having links to Chinese intelligence. Beijing has rejected the allegations. Nvidia's board says it has no reason to believe company secrets or national security were compromised. But the affair has opened up a much bigger question: what did the administration in Washington know, and what did it do about it? That question leads directly to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. His department was responsible for controlling exports of sensitive American technology. It was also being pressed to act on concerns about Megaspeed, an Nvidia customer suspected of helping divert advanced chips to China. On Thursday, Megaspeed chief executive, Tan Yong Pong, also known as James Tan, said the company "takes its compliance obligations under US export control laws extremely seriously" and is "committed to working constructively and transparently with the US government". He said the company had co-operated with US Commerce Department inspections. A highly classified memo was shared with Lutnick about the concerns surrounding Alice Huang and Megaspeed. He resisted taking action against the company, a decision that is now under scrutiny. Other senior officials wanted a tougher response. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was among those who reportedly questioned why Megaspeed had not been placed on the Commerce Department's blacklist. On Friday, Bessent pointed the finger at Commerce for not blacklisting the company, telling CNBC that several government agencies "were in favour of putting Megaspeed on the entity list for months". "But Commerce has the pen... and you will have to ask them about their internal process," he added. There have also been questions about why an investigation into the Singapore-based company was stopped after Nvidia intervened. The New York Times reported that Nvidia's general counsel contacted Commerce Department investigators probing suspected chip smuggling by Megaspeed invoking a senior Trump appointee. The department allegedly then froze its investigation and handed the case to the Justice Department. This apparently highlighted a significant disagreement about the direction of Trump's China policy. Huang wanted access to the Chinese market. Other officials were supposedly worried about the national security consequences. Lutnick was caught in the middle. Now the political pressure is building. Members of Congress from both parties want answers. Democrats have launched an investigation into how the Commerce Department vetted Chinese companies approved to buy AI chips. Republicans are also questioning the administration's approach. And Jensen Huang's departure has not eased the pressure. Republican representative John Moolenaar, who chairs the House Select Committee on China, said it was in the national interest for Nvidia and other American AI firms to succeed, but that companies "should never jeopardise our nation's security" by giving Chinese firms access to their most advanced chips. Senator Elizabeth Warren, the top Democrat on the Senate Banking Committee, said Huang's resignation did not absolve him of responsibility, and urged Lutnick to explain why export control loopholes remain open. Meanwhile Jensen Huang's team told Republican lawmakers on Wednesday that he plans to cooperate with their request to testify behind closed doors. The White House has not responded to the BBC's request for comment. It has, however, told the New York Post that Trump has complete confidence in Lutnick, describing him as "the most transformative commerce secretary in modern history". That is a fairly emphatic show of support, particularly amid reports that officials are weighing whether Lutnick should be forced out. There are some obvious questions. If Lutnick had indeed been warned about the risks, why did his department fail to act? And if other senior officials were indeed pressing for action, why did it take so long? The BBC has contacted the Commerce Department for comment. But there is an even bigger question for Trump. The president cultivated a close relationship with Huang. He was directly involved in decisions about chip sales to China. And, according to reporting in the New York Times, he was briefed on the intelligence concerns. This is becoming difficult to dismiss as the misjudgement of one businessman or one government department. Jensen Huang's personal life may have triggered the crisis, but the questions now reach into the White House itself. How much influence did he have? What did the president know? And who was ultimately responsible for protecting America's most sensitive technology?

articles.summary: Police suspect the group drew up fictitious loan agreements to disguise crypto trading proceeds it transferred directly into bank accounts.

articles.titleTr: Israeli police arrest five in $5M WhatsApp crypto trading probe
articles.summaryTr: Police suspect the group drew up fictitious loan agreements to disguise crypto trading proceeds it transferred directly into bank accounts.
articles.articleText: Israeli police arrest five in $5M WhatsApp crypto trading probe Police suspect the group drew up fictitious loan agreements to disguise crypto trading proceeds it transferred directly into bank accounts. Israeli police arrested five people on Tuesday in a money laundering investigation involving about 16 million shekels ($5 million) in crypto transactions arranged through a WhatsApp group. Investigators from the National Unit for Combating Economic Crime within Lahav 433 suspect the group provided crypto services without a license and failed to report transactions to Israel’s tax authorities. Police allege the group used fictitious agreements to make crypto proceeds transferred into bank accounts look like loans, according to The Jerusalem Post. Authorities seized wallets, computers and tens of thousands of shekels in cash while searching the suspects’ homes. Investigators questioned the five on suspicion of money laundering, fraud and providing financial asset services without a license. Israel’s Tax Authority announced two other arrests on Oct. 6 in cases involving suspected failures to report crypto activity. One involved trades worth tens of millions of dollars. In the other, an Ashdod resident allegedly failed to report income from about $13 million in crypto trades between 2019 and 2021. A November 2024 audit by Israel’s State Comptroller found that about 500 people reported crypto activity each year on average from 2018 to 2022, out of at least 200,000 potential filers. Related: DOJ moves to seize $1.2B from Binance hack, disrupts FaceStealer scam

articles.title: Unocoin keeps deposits and withdrawals halted over suspect transfers
articles.summary: Unocoin said the transfers were signed and broadcast outside BitGo’s platform, and BitGo said the account freeze worked as intended.

articles.titleTr: Unocoin keeps deposits and withdrawals halted over suspect transfers
articles.summaryTr: Unocoin said the transfers were signed and broadcast outside BitGo’s platform, and BitGo said the account freeze worked as intended.
articles.articleText: Unocoin keeps deposits and withdrawals halted over suspect transfers Unocoin said the transfers were signed and broadcast outside BitGo’s platform, and BitGo said the account freeze worked as intended. Update (Nov. 13, 2026, 12:30 pm UTC): This article has been updated to include BitGo’s response and clarify that the account freeze applied to activity routed through BitGo’s platform. Indian cryptocurrency exchange Unocoin has kept deposits and withdrawals suspended as it investigates suspicious wallet transfers and a breach of its own systems. BitGo froze Unocoin’s enterprise account on Nov. 6 at the exchange’s request. Unocoin said the freeze appeared to have worked as intended and that the transfers were signed and broadcast onchain outside BitGo’s platform, according to its Friday update. “Our review found that the transaction examined was signed using the user and backup keys held by Unocoin and broadcast externally onchain, without BitGo’s participation. BitGo’s systems were not breached in connection with that transaction,” BitGo said in a statement to Cointelegraph. The company said the freeze applied only to activity routed through its platform and that the transfers were signed using keys Unocoin held outside BitGo’s systems. Unocoin said it was investigating possible use of the wallet’s backup signing option and whether any cryptocurrency was lost. The exchange did not respond to Cointelegraph’s request for more information before publication. Unocoin first detected unauthorized activity on Nov. 6 and suspended all services on Monday after detecting further activity. On Thursday, it disclosed outgoing transfers from an Ethereum address associated with its BitGo wallets and said its infrastructure had been compromised. A Nov. 5 warning from India’s cybersecurity agency described an AI-assisted campaign targeting crypto exchanges and other financial firms. No connection to Unocoin’s incident has been established. Related: India plans first tokenized bonds using wholesale CBDC: Report

articles.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

news.title: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
news.summary: Microsoft says it is continuing to restore services including Outlook and Teams following a global outage.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
news.summaryTr: Microsoft says it is continuing to restore services including Outlook and Teams following a global outage.
news.articleText: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost? - Published A major Microsoft outage has impacted schools, healthcare systems, businesses, courts and governments around the world. Services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot, are being restored almost 24 hours since issues first surfaced. Microsoft said the outage was not a cyber-security incident and was caused by a technical issue. It has apologised for the disruption. Here's what we know about the services affected and what went wrong. What happened? Microsoft 365 Services, including Teams, Outlook and Microsoft's artificial intelligence software Copilot, have been affected by "connectivity problems". From late on Thursday, customers reported varying levels of access - many were unable to send or receive emails, view certain files or details on their calendar apps. But some users were able to use Teams, messaging and online meeting functions without issues. As of Friday afternoon, Microsoft said it had seen "encouraging recovery progress" in Europe and improvement in North America. The company added that it was focused on "addressing the remaining areas of disruption" but warned "some users may still experience intermittent issues". In a later statement, the company said it was continuing to see improvements "with email queues significantly reduced and approaching normal levels". The company attributed the ongoing outage to "elevated load" on its infrastructure, saying it stemmed from an issue during an earlier network capacity upgrade. Will emails sent during the outage ever arrive? Although services are beginning to resume, Microsoft has warned of continued "intermittent access issues", meaning some users will still struggle to load their inboxes and could experience "delayed email delivery". In other words, it is not quite safe to assume every email you send is going to arrive in its intended recipient's inbox right away. Earlier, Microsoft said it would be extending the "timeout window" to 48 hours "to help protect delayed messages as delivery catches up". The email timeout window refers to the amount of time Outlook will wait to receive an email. When they do show up, the timestamp will be when they were delivered rather than when they were sent. Why has it taken so long to fix? Although email service Outlook appears to be resuming, the outage has so far lasted for more than 20 hours - in outage terms that is considered a long time. Prof James Ferryman from the University of Reading's department of computer science said the details the company has disclosed provide some clues. "What Microsoft has told us is that the part of its servers that sets up secure connections is getting swamped, and once that happens the server just stops answering," he said. "The trouble is that this kind of failure snowballs. "One server falls over, its work gets passed to the next one, and meanwhile huge numbers of phones and laptops keep trying to get back in. "You can't just turn it all back on at once. You have to bring it back bit by bit." The challenge is therefore not just fixing the fault, but managing the huge surge of devices trying to reconnect once services start coming back online. Gergely Orosz, a former leading software engineer at several major tech companies including Skype and Uber, said this could be the "most disruptive" business email outage "of all time". He said it was still difficult to know just how many people have been affected by the disruption, but added he "cannot recall" an outage over business email ever taking this long to return to normal. Australian cyber-security expert Troy Hunt told the BBC the outage could have far-reaching consequences. "Microsoft is a massive part of the internet backbone and reminds us how critical email still is. "Not only does this outage affect many people's ability to work but also things like the ability to communicate about appointments, purchase things that need verification, create or access accounts and services," he said. In a statement, Microsoft said it was "deeply sorry for the disruption this incident has caused our customers and partners. "We know the trust they place in our services and take that responsibility extremely seriously. We are seeing broad recovery and stability across our services." How many people have been affected? More than 430 million people use Microsoft 365 apps according to Microsoft's website. The full scale of the outage has not been confirmed. Microsoft 365 is used by companies worldwide and is expected to have a knock-on effect to other services. Tech giants OpenAI and Anthropic both earlier reported problems as a result of the outage. ChatGPT-maker OpenAI said it was investigating an issue affecting its connections to Microsoft's services, which had caused some tools to not work as expected. From city governments in the US to Australian spy agencies, disruption across the globe has been widespread. Courts from Los Angeles to Texas warned that communications might be delayed. In Canada, the public broadcaster CBC reported that a healthcare network running several hospitals in Toronto was experiencing email issues, but that patient care was not affected. The government of Japan also said its shared IT platform had been disrupted. Across the UK, GP surgeries, pharmacies, police and schools have been affected by the outage. Some GP surgeries have urged patients not to submit messages via their website while the problem remains, while several large police forces are urging members of the public to call if they want to make a report. Additional reporting by Henry Moore Get in touch Have you or your business been affected by the outage?

news.title: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
news.summary: The fact the question of European security now features in discussions is viewed in Moscow as a victory, BBC Russia Editor Steve Rosenberg says.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
news.summaryTr: The fact the question of European security now features in discussions is viewed in Moscow as a victory, BBC Russia Editor Steve Rosenberg says.
news.articleText: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine - Published Russia's President Vladimir Putin says he wishes "eternal peace" for Ukraine. That is the same Russian president who ordered the full-scale invasion of Russia's neighbour nearly five years ago and who continues to reject the idea of a comprehensive ceasefire. And what, in Moscow's view, is a prerequisite for peace? The Kremlin spelt it out after talks with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner: "A new, long-term architecture of indivisible security and peace." Translated from Kremlin-speak, it means Moscow wants to change the security set-up of Europe in a way that benefits Russia. What Russia is pushing for is, potentially, the biggest change to European security arrangements since the end of the Cold War. The Kremlin has put back on the table its controversial proposal from December 2021 – the "draft treaties" with the US and Nato which would not only have put the brakes on the alliance's eastward enlargement by giving Moscow cast-iron guarantees that, for instance, Ukraine and Georgia would never be allowed to join, but also rolled back Nato military infrastructure from countries of central and eastern Europe which became Nato members following the dissolution of the Soviet Union. Western leaders dismissed such demands as an unacceptable Russian ultimatum. Two months later Moscow launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine. The "draft treaties" were put away. Now they are out of the geopolitical filing cabinet, and being quoted again by the Kremlin. What is more, Yuri Ushakov, Putin's foreign policy aide, has suggested that Moscow is about to "add certain new considerations" to its list of demands in light of Western efforts "to inflict a strategic defeat on Russia". That does not mean, of course, that Western governments will accept them. But the fact that the question of European security is featuring now in discussions on Ukraine is viewed here as a victory for Moscow. "In December 2021 Russia actively proposed that Nato rethink the security system in Europe," wrote newspaper Komsomolskaya Pravda earlier this week. "Our proposals were almost laughed at. "Having secured one victory by forcing the West to think about security, our diplomats need a second by making the West heed Russia's concerns about Nato enlargement." The EU's top diplomat, Kaja Kallas, has called Russia's demands for a new European security architecture a "trap" designed to "shift attention away from a ceasefire". "The sequencing of Ukraine-Russia talks is important," Kallas wrote on social media. "The priority should be securing a ceasefire, followed by a peace agreement. Only then can there be discussions on Europe's wider security architecture." Europe's problem is that, right now, it is not at the table. Moscow has had no desire to give it a chair. It has slammed European leaders for their military support for Kyiv and tough stance on Russia. This week's peace talks in Abu Dhabi involved Ukraine, Russia and the US. After his discussions in Moscow, Witkoff indicated that Putin had agreed to the idea of European representatives joining the next round of Ukraine peace talks. But on Friday the Kremlin indicated a final decision on European participation had not been taken. "Once we understand their true intentions and their readiness to facilitate the peace process, then it will be possible to take a decision about dialogue on Ukraine in a wider format," said Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov. - Zelensky welcomes US bringing Europe into Russia-Ukraine peace talks - Published15 hours ago - Europe's security 'fundamentally reshaped' by war in Ukraine - Published1 day ago - Inside devastated front-line city that Russia wants Ukraine to give up - Published3 days ago And what of Putin? At the talks with Witkoff and Kushner he was sounding uncompromising and confident. You can see why. The Americans are knocking at his door and seeking a deal and the Europeans are contemplating contacts with him. Last month the leaders of Norway and Finland reached out and called him. And next week in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Co-operation summit, Putin may have a separate meeting with Donald Trump and Xi Jinping. Russian media are already comparing them to the "Big Three" - Stalin, Roosevelt and Churchill - who met in 1945 to reorganise post-World War Two Europe. And yet, after nearly five years of war, Russia has suffered huge losses on the battlefield. The Russian economy is under increasing pressure. Ukrainian drone strikes continue to target Russian oil refineries, sparking fears of new fuel shortages. But, so far, none of this has convinced the Kremlin leader to end the fighting.

But the fact that the question of European security is featuring now in discussions on Ukraine is viewed here as a victory for Moscow. "In December 2021 Russia actively proposed that Nato rethink the security system in Europe," wrote newspaper Komsomolskaya Pravda earlier this week. "Our proposals were almost laughed at. "Having secured one victory by forcing the West to think about security, our diplomats need a second by making the West heed Russia's concerns about Nato enlargement." The EU's top diplomat, Kaja Kallas, has called Russia's demands for a new European security architecture a "trap" designed to "shift attention away from a ceasefire". "The sequencing of Ukraine-Russia talks is important," Kallas wrote on social media. "The priority should be securing a ceasefire, followed by a peace agreement. Only then can there be discussions on Europe's wider security architecture." Europe's problem is that, right now, it is not at the table. Moscow has had no desire to give it a chair. It has slammed European leaders for their military support for Kyiv and tough stance on Russia. This week's peace talks in Abu Dhabi involved Ukraine, Russia and the US. After his discussions in Moscow, Witkoff indicated that Putin had agreed to the idea of European representatives joining the next round of Ukraine peace talks. But on Friday the Kremlin indicated a final decision on European participation had not been taken. "Once we understand their true intentions and their readiness to facilitate the peace process, then it will be possible to take a decision about dialogue on Ukraine in a wider format," said Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov. - Zelensky welcomes US bringing Europe into Russia-Ukraine peace talks - Published15 hours ago - Europe's security 'fundamentally reshaped' by war in Ukraine - Published1 day ago - Inside devastated front-line city that Russia wants Ukraine to give up - Published3 days ago And what of Putin? At the talks with Witkoff and Kushner he was sounding uncompromising and confident. You can see why. The Americans are knocking at his door and seeking a deal and the Europeans are contemplating contacts with him. Last month the leaders of Norway and Finland reached out and called him. And next week in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Co-operation summit, Putin may have a separate meeting with Donald Trump and Xi Jinping. Russian media are already comparing them to the "Big Three" - Stalin, Roosevelt and Churchill - who met in 1945 to reorganise post-World War Two Europe. And yet, after nearly five years of war, Russia has suffered huge losses on the battlefield. The Russian economy is under increasing pressure. Ukrainian drone strikes continue to target Russian oil refineries, sparking fears of new fuel shortages. But, so far, none of this has convinced the Kremlin leader to end the fighting.

news.title: FTSE Russell'dan Borsa İstanbul kararı: Yeni hisse eklemeleri Mart 2027'ye ertelendi
news.summary: Uluslararası endeks sağlayıcısı FTSE Russell, Türkiye'nin piyasa statüsünde değişikliğe gitmedi. Türkiye, “gelişmiş gelişmekte olan piyasa” statüsünü korurken izleme listesine de alınmadı.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: FTSE Russell'dan Borsa İstanbul kararı: Yeni hisse eklemeleri Mart 2027'ye ertelendi
news.summaryTr: Uluslararası endeks sağlayıcısı FTSE Russell, Türkiye'nin piyasa statüsünde değişikliğe gitmedi. Türkiye, “gelişmiş gelişmekte olan piyasa” statüsünü korurken izleme listesine de alınmadı.
news.articleText: FTSE Russell'dan Borsa İstanbul kararı: Yeni hisse eklemeleri Mart 2027'ye ertelendi - FTSE Russell, Türkiye'nin gelişmiş gelişen piyasa statüsünü korudu ancak Borsa İstanbul hisselerine yönelik kısıtlamaların devamına karar verdi. - Buna göre Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören şirketlerin endekslere yeni dahil edilmesi ve halka açıklık oranlarındaki artışların endekslere yansıtılması en erken Mart 2027 değerlendirmesinde yeniden ele alınacak. Küresel endeks sağlayıcısı FTSE Russell, 13 Kasım 2026 tarihinde yayımladığı aralık ayı endeks değerlendirmesinde Türkiye'ye ilişkin uygulamaları duyurdu. FTSE Russell Türkiye için kararını açıkladı CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Kuruluş, Türkiye'de sermaye piyasalarının şeffaflığını artırmaya yönelik düzenlemeleri olumlu karşıladığını ancak bu adımların etkinliğini değerlendirmek için daha uzun bir gözlem süresine ihtiyaç duyulduğunu bildirdi. FTSE Russell, Türkiye'nin gelişmiş gelişen piyasalar kategorisindeki statüsünün değişmediğini ve ülkenin izleme listesine alınmadığını da teyit etti. Türkiye'nin attığı adımlar olumlu karşılandı FTSE Russell, Türkiye'de gerçekleştirilen düzenlemeler arasında ortaklık payı bildirim eşiğinin yüzde 5'ten yüzde 3'e indirilmesini, Merkezi Kayıt Kuruluşunun fiili dolaşım oranlarına ilişkin daha ayrıntılı veri sağlamasını ve şüpheli yüksek ortak yoğunlaşmasıyla bağlantılı bazı yatırım fonlarının tasfiyesini olumlu gelişmeler olarak sıraladı. Kuruluş ayrıca koordineli işlem faaliyetleri ve piyasa bozucu davranışlara yönelik denetim ve yaptırımların sürdüğüne dikkat çekti. Bununla birlikte düzenlemelerin etkisinin ölçülebilmesi için daha fazla zamana ihtiyaç duyulduğu vurgulandı. Borsa İstanbul'da yeni hisse eklemeleri ertelendi FTSE Russell, eylül ayında uygulamaya alınan kısıtlamaların aralık ayı değerlendirmesinde de devam edeceğini açıkladı. Bu kapsamda; Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören şirketlerin FTSE endekslerine yeni dahil edilmesi, Halka arzlar yoluyla gerçekleştirilecek yeni eklemeler, Fiili dolaşımdaki pay oranlarındaki artışların endeks hesaplamalarına yansıtılması, Büyük, orta, küçük ve mikro ölçekli şirketler arasındaki endeks segmenti değişiklikleri en erken Mart 2027 değerlendirmesine kadar ertelenecek. Ağırlık Düzeltme Faktörü (WAF) güncellemeleri de şirketin ilgili endeksten çıkarılmasına neden olan işlemler dışında uygulanmayacak. Aralık ayında hangi işlemler yapılabilecek? Kısıtlamalara rağmen FTSE Russell, aralık ayında bazı endeks güncellemelerinin devam edeceğini bildirdi. Sektör sınıflandırması değişiklikleri, üç aylık pay sayısı güncellemeleri ve belirlenen eşikler çerçevesindeki fiili dolaşım oranı düşüşleri uygulanabilecek. Ayrıca işlem sırası kapalı olan, gözetim ve likidite kriterlerini karşılamayan veya piyasa değeri belirlenen sınırların altına düşen şirketler için endeksten çıkarma işlemleri sürdürülecek. Bölünmelerden kaynaklanan ölçek sınıfı değişiklikleri, endeks ağırlık üst sınırı güncellemeleri ve ESG, etik yatırım ile İslami yatırım kriterlerine ilişkin özel dışlama listeleri de güncellenebilecek. Gözler Mart 2027 değerlendirmesinde FTSE Russell, Türkiye'deki düzenleyici otoritelerle temasını ve piyasa gelişmelerine yönelik izleme sürecini sürdüreceğini açıkladı. Endeks değişikliklerine ilişkin kısıtlamaların kaldırılıp kaldırılmayacağına yönelik yeni kararların Mart 2027 değerlendirmesi öncesinde ele alınması bekleniyor. FTSE Russell nedir? FTSE Russell, dünya genelinde hisse senedi ve tahvil piyasalarına yönelik endeksler hazırlayan uluslararası bir endeks sağlayıcısıdır. Kuruluşun ülke sınıflandırmaları, uluslararası yatırımcıların piyasalara erişimini ve endeksleri takip eden fonların portföy dağılımlarını etkileyebiliyor.

news.title: Galatasaray'dan Metin Öztürk ve Abdullah Kavukcu için istifa açıklaması
news.summary: Galatasaray, yöneticilerden Abdullah Kavukcu ve Metin Öztürk'ün istifa ettiğini açıkladı.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Galatasaray'dan Metin Öztürk ve Abdullah Kavukcu için istifa açıklaması
news.summaryTr: Galatasaray, yöneticilerden Abdullah Kavukcu ve Metin Öztürk'ün istifa ettiğini açıkladı.
news.articleText: Galatasaray'dan Metin Öztürk ve Abdullah Kavukcu için istifa açıklaması - Galatasaray'da yaşanan Metin Öztürk-Abdullah Kavukçu kavgası iki ismin istifası ile sonuçlanmıştı. - Barıştırma çabaları sonuç vermeyince istifalar işleme konuldu. Galatasaray'da geçtiğimiz günlerde Metin Öztürk ile Abdullah Kavukcu arasında tatsız olaylar yaşanmıştı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Sarı-kırmızılu kulüp, iki yöneticinin de istifa ettiğini duyurdu. Kulüpten yapılan açıklamalarda şu ifadeler kullanıldı: "Galatasaray Spor Kulübü İkinci Başkanı Sayın Metin Öztürk, görevinden istifa etmiştir. Kendisine görev süresi boyunca kulübümüze vermiş olduğu emek ve katkılardan dolayı teşekkür ediyoruz. Galatasaray Spor Kulübü Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi Sayın Abdullah Kavukcu, görevinden istifa etmiştir. Kendisine görev süresi boyunca kulübümüze vermiş olduğu emek ve katkılardan dolayı teşekkür ediyoruz." Ne olmuştu? Metin Öztürk, 1 Kasım'da yaptığı açıklamada fiili saldırıya maruz kaldığını ve merhum annesine hakaret edildiğini öne sürmüştü. Kavukcu ise yaşananların toplantı sonrasında karşılıklı bir sözlü tartışma olduğunu iddia etmişti.

news.summary: Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksi haftayı yüzde 3,14 yükselişle tamamlarken, gram altın yüzde 3,53 değer kaybetti. Dolar/TL yükselirken avro/TL geriledi. Yatırım fonları arasında haftanın en çok kazandıranı ise hisse senedi fonları oldu.

news.titleTr: Borsa, dolar ve altın haftayı nasıl kapattı? İşte haftanın kazandıran ve kaybettiren yatırım araçları
news.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksi haftayı yüzde 3,14 yükselişle tamamlarken, gram altın yüzde 3,53 değer kaybetti. Dolar/TL yükselirken avro/TL geriledi. Yatırım fonları arasında haftanın en çok kazandıranı ise hisse senedi fonları oldu.
news.articleText: Borsa, dolar ve altın haftayı nasıl kapattı? İşte haftanın kazandıran ve kaybettiren yatırım araçları - Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksi haftayı yüzde 3,14 yükselişle tamamlarken, gram altın yüzde 3,53 değer kaybetti. - Dolar/TL yükselirken euro/TL geriledi. - Yatırım fonları arasında haftanın en çok kazandıranı ise hisse senedi fonları oldu. BIST 100 endeksi hafta içinde en düşük 11.521,40, en yüksek 11.842,82 puanı gördü. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Endeks, haftalık bazda yüzde 3,14 değer kazanarak 11.842,82 puandan kapanış yaptı. Altın fiyatlarında düşüş Kapalıçarşı'da işlem gören 24 ayar külçe altının gram satış fiyatı haftalık bazda yüzde 3,53 düşüşle 6 bin 290 liraya geriledi. Cumhuriyet altınının satış fiyatı yüzde 3,45 azalarak 41 bin 448 liraya, çeyrek altının satış fiyatı ise yüzde 3,20 düşüşle 10 bin 406 liraya indi. Dolar yükseldi, euro geriledi Döviz piyasasında dolar/TL haftayı yüzde 0,42 artışla 50,3690 liradan tamamlarken, euro/TL yüzde 0,38 düşüşle 55,7140 liraya geriledi. Yatırım fonlarında hisse senedi fonları öne çıktı Yatırım fonları haftalık bazda yüzde 0,70, emeklilik fonları yüzde 1,05 değer kazandı. Yatırım fonları kategorileri incelendiğinde, yüzde 2,62 getiriyle hisse senedi fonları haftanın en çok kazandıran fon kategorisi oldu.

news.summary: Maryland Senator Van Hollen says "new leadership" is needed for Democrats following the party's recent midterm successes.

news.titleTr: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge
news.summaryTr: Maryland Senator Van Hollen says "new leadership" is needed for Democrats following the party's recent midterm successes.
news.articleText: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge - Published US Senator Chuck Schumer is facing a challenge to his position as US Senate majority leader from his fellow Democratic Senator Chris Van Hollen, as the party prepares to take control of Congress after sweeping the midterm elections. Van Hollen, 67, said in a post on X on Thursday that Americans voted for change earlier this month and "to deliver, we need new leadership". Schumer, 75, has led Democrats in the chamber since 2017, serving as both majority and minority leader. He was first elected to the Senate in 1999. Following the midterms earlier this month, his position has come under pressure by some left-wing Democrats who see him as too moderate and part of the party establishment. Responding to the challenge, Schumer, who represents New York, said he welcomes "any discussion about the future of our caucus and the important work ahead". He added that he is "proud of what we've accomplished together" in the midterms, and he has "the votes to continue as Democratic leader". The vote on Senate leader will be held behind closed doors in early December and the winner will assume the role on 4 January, when Democrats take control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives after their midterms successes. The move by Van Hollen, who represents Maryland, marks the most significant step by a high-profile Democrat to challenge the party's existing leadership following last week's midterms victory. Announcing his plans to run on X, he wrote that Americans had called on the party to "unrig an economy rigged against working people". In recent years, Van Hollen has taken positions popular with those on the left of his party. In 2024, he supported restricting weapons shipments to Israel and criticised the Biden administration over its role in the war in Gaza. In an interview with MS NOW, Van Hollen - who has served in the Senate for nearly a decade - acknowledged that he is an "underdog" but added that he believes the race is "very much in flux". Independent Senator Bernie Sanders and Democratic Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed have both publicly come out in support of Van Hollen - while others have also called for new leadership. In a post on X, Sanders said he believes Van Hollen "will stand up to powerful special interests, take on the billionaire class and fight for working families". El-Sayed said the challenger would bring "bold leadership" and lead with both "courage and experience". Others Democrats have publicly backed Schumer. Senator Jacky Rosen of Nevada said: "He has the experience and the fight to continue leading our diverse caucus at this crucial moment". Senator Kirsten Gillibrand said: "You will see, despite all the grumblings, enormous gratitude for the hard work he has done to get us to this position." - Published16 hours ago - Published1 day ago - Published2 days ago

news.title: CFTC Files Lawsuit Against Arkansas as the Agency Defends its Federal Jurisdiction Over Prediction Markets
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Files Lawsuit Against Arkansas as the Agency Defends its Federal Jurisdiction Over Prediction Markets
news.articleText: Release Number 9325-26 CFTC Files Lawsuit Against Arkansas as the Agency Defends its Federal Jurisdiction Over Prediction Markets November 13, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced that it has filed a lawsuit against Arkansas to block the state’s attempts to halt event-contract trading and impose up to hundreds of millions of dollars in civil penalties on CFTC-registered exchanges. Arkansas is bringing a civil enforcement against Kalshi in state court, a CFTC-designated contract market. Arkansas’s efforts to obstruct the functions of CFTC-registered exchanges operating lawfully under the Commodity Exchange Act are preempted by federal law. “As prediction markets continue to prove their value in being useful for risk management and providing the public with valuable information about the future, Arkansas seeks to shut down event contracts ranging from sports and politics to other important world events,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “The CFTC will continue to defend its sole jurisdiction over these federally regulated markets as granted by Congress under the Commodity Exchange Act, and the Commission will not let state interference thwart its regulatory efforts and destroy federally regulated markets.” Arkansas is the 11th state the CFTC has sued to vindicate federal sovereign interests. The CFTC has also submitted amicus briefs in four federal Courts of Appeal and one state Supreme Court. -CFTC-

news.title: German spies handed new powers to tackle 'hybrid threats' from abroad
news.summary: German reforms mean foreign and domestic intelligence services will have greater powers to combat espionage, terrorism and sabotage.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: German spies handed new powers to tackle 'hybrid threats' from abroad
news.summaryTr: German reforms mean foreign and domestic intelligence services will have greater powers to combat espionage, terrorism and sabotage.
news.articleText: German spies handed new powers to tackle 'hybrid threats' from abroad - Published Germany's foreign and domestic intelligence services are to be given greater powers to combat espionage, terrorism and sabotage after the country's parliament, the Bundestag, approved a major overhaul of its legislation. Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt, who championed the bill, has called it a "reform of the century", necessary because of the increasing threats from foreign powers. But the Left Party's security spokeswoman, Clara Bünger, said Dobrindt was creating a new German secret police. The legislation gives numerous new powers to Germany's BND federal intelligence service, and its BfV domestic service, the Federal Office for the Protection of the Constitution. In the Bundestag, 309 MPs voted in favour of the new law on intelligence services, while 190 voted against and 71 abstained. For historical reasons, German intelligence has mainly focused on gathering information rather than acting on it. In future, German spies working for the BND, which is responsible for foreign intelligence, will be able to conduct covert operations abroad, including sabotage. This could include paralysing the servers of state-sponsored hacker groups, disrupting disinformation networks, or even disrupting supply chains for weapons. Agents for the domestic intelligence service, the BfV, will no longer to be limited to gathering information. For the first time they will be able to take protective action against property and IT systems, if specific threats are identified. That means they will be allowed to dismantle or break explosives or weapons, divert or block data flows during cyber-attacks, delete or falsify data stored for malicious purposes, and plant false information on those involved. - Sabotage suspect held in Germany after spate of attacks on power grid - Published8 September - Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack - Published2 September Under certain conditions, BfV agents will also be permitted to enter homes covertly. However, the measure must always be authorised in advance. They will also be given wider powers of digital surveillance, including monitoring encrypted telecommunications and carrying out online searches. They will also be allowed to use AI-supported data analysis and biometric image matching on the internet. The government says the reform is needed because of an increase in foreign espionage, particularly from Russia, China and Iran. "We are the target of hybrid threats," said Dobrindt. "Germany is a theatre of operations for terrorism, extremism and foreign powers." In August, a drone carrying an explosive device was discovered at Leipzig Airport, close to Ukrainian cargo planes. However, it failed to explode as the bomb's detonator was apparently faulty. German authorities say Russia was behind the attack. The new law has been bitterly criticised by some opposition politicians, even though Dobrindt has said it is "madness" to think it means that Germany is creating a new secret police. And Clara Bünger from the Left Party told public broadcaster ARD that the new law was "a monster… summoning ghosts that we will probably never be able to get rid of". The separation between the police and the secret service, she warned, was "being eroded" - and Bünger said that had been a lesson learned from the Nazi era. "This means the secret service is being granted executive powers and will not only be allowed to act pre-emptively, but will also be granted police powers." However, Sonja Eichwede of the centre-left SPD, which is part of Germany's governing coalition, said the reforms would make a significant contribution to ensuring the country's democracy was "robust and resilient".

news.titleTr: Türkiye ile Katar arasında 5 anlaşma! Erdoğan ve Al Sani'den kritik imza
news.summaryTr: Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ile Katar Emiri Şeyh Temim bin Hamed Al Sani'nin görüşmesinin ardından Türkiye ile Katar arasında 5 anlaşma imzalandı. Ticaret, eğitim, diplomasi ve savunma alanlarını kapsayan anlaşmalar arasında karşılıklı savunma anlaşması da yer aldı.
news.articleText: Türkiye ile Katar arasında 5 anlaşma! Erdoğan ve Al Sani'den kritik imza - Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ile Katar Emiri Şeyh Temim bin Hamed Al Sani'nin görüşmesinin ardından Türkiye ile Katar arasında 5 anlaşma imzalandı. - Ticaret, eğitim, diplomasi ve savunma alanlarını kapsayan anlaşmalar arasında karşılıklı savunma anlaşması da yer aldı. Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan, Katar Emiri Şeyh Temim bin Hamed Al Sani'yi Cumhurbaşkanlığı Dolmabahçe Ofisi'nde resmi törenle karşıladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Heyetlerin tanıtılmasının ardından iki lider baş başa görüşmeye geçti. Basına kapalı gerçekleştirilen görüşmede Dışişleri Bakanı Hakan Fidan ve MİT Başkanı İbrahim Kalın da hazır bulundu. Görüşmenin ardından heyetler arası toplantıya geçildi. İki ülke arasında hangi anlaşmalar imzalandı? Türkiye-Katar Yüksek Stratejik Komitesi'nin 12. Toplantısı kapsamında iki ülke arasında 5 anlaşmaya imza atıldı. İmzalanan anlaşmalar şöyle sıralandı: Tüketicinin korunması, piyasa gözetimi ve denetimi alanlarında işbirliği mutabakatı Eğitim alanında işbirliği anlaşması Barış, uzlaşma ve çatışma çözümü konusunda işbirliği mutabakatı Yüksek Stratejik Komite 12. Toplantısı Ortak Bildirisi Karşılıklı Savunma Anlaşması. Anlaşmaların imza törenine Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan ve Katar Emiri Al Sani de katıldı. Türkiye ile Katar arasındaki Yüksek Stratejik Komite, iki ülke arasındaki siyasi, ekonomik ve güvenlik ilişkilerini geliştirmek amacıyla faaliyet gösteriyor. Komite toplantılarında ikili ilişkilerin yanı sıra bölgesel ve uluslararası gelişmeler de ele alınıyor.

news.titleTr: Borsa günü yükselişle kapadı
news.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul ve VİOP'ta haftanın son işlem gününde yatırımcılar, saat 10.00'da açıklanacak cari denge verisini takip ediyor. BIST 100 ve BIST 30 endekslerinin seyri, bankacılık ve sanayi hisselerindeki fiyat değişimleri, günün yükselen ve düşen hisse senetleri, işlem hacimleri canlı haberimizde.
news.articleText: Borsa günü yükselişle kapadı - BIST 100 endeksi günü 31,63 puan (%0,27) artışla 11.842,82 puandan tamamladı. Borsa İstanbul'da yükseliş hızlandı. Sanayi sektörü şirketlerinin öne çıkan performanslarıyla BIST 100, BIST 30 ve BIST SINAİ endekslerinde günlük artış yüzde 1'in üzerine çıktı. Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksi, günün ilk yarısında yüzde 0,44 değer kazanarak 11.863,39 puana yükseldi. Endeks, günün ilk yarısında en düşük 11.748,37, en yüksek 11.885,12 puanı gördü. Toplam işlem hacmi 55,4 milyar lira oldu. Bankacılık endeksi yüzde 0,05 değer kaybederken, holding endeksi yüzde 0,31 değer kazandı. Sektör endeksleri arasında en çok kazandıran yüzde 2,61 ile finansal kiralama faktoring, en fazla kaybeden ise yüzde 0,52 ile metal eşya oldu. Günün ilk yarısında hizmetler endeksi yüzde 0,93, sanayi endeksi yüzde 0,60, teknoloji endeksi yüzde 0,48 ve mali endeks yüzde 0,44 değer kazandı. Önceki kapanışa kıyasla günün ilk yarısında BIST 100 endeksine dahil hisselerden 65'i yükselirken 28'i düştü, 7'si yatay seyretti. En çok işlem gören hisse senetleri ASELSAN, Astor Enerji, Koç Holding, Tüpraş ile Türk Hava Yolları oldu. Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksinde yer alan Cw Enerji Muhendislik (CWENE) ve Zorlu Enerji (ZOREN) hisseleri önde giderken BIST 30 endeksine bakıldığında Türk Telekom (TTKOM) öne çıkıyor. CWENE, saat 11:45 itibarıyla çyüzde 5,5 yükselişte, ZOREN, yüzde 5,44 yükselişte. TTKOM'un primi ise yüzde 2,45. Bununla beraber BIST 100 ve BIST 30 endeksleri dünkü kapanışına göre yatay seyirde ilerliyor. Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksi, güne yüzde 0,05 düşüşle 11.805,48 puandan başladı. Endeks, bugün açılışta önceki kapanışa göre 5,71 puan ve yüzde 0,05 azalışla 11.805,48 puana indi. Bankacılık endeksi yüzde 0,40, holding endeksi yüzde 0,11 değer kaybetti. Sektör endeksleri arasında en fazla kazandıran yüzde 2,19 ile finansal kiralama faktoring, en çok kaybettiren yüzde 0,88 ile ulaştırma oldu. Dün alış ağırlıklı bir seyir izleyen Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksi, günü yüzde 1,24 değer kazanarak 11.811,19 puandan tamamlamıştı. news.title: At least 24 killed after bus collides with truck in north-east India
news.summary: Several of the deceased are college students, according to local official Atul Bora, but they have not yet been publicly identified.

news.titleTr: At least 24 killed after bus collides with truck in north-east India
news.summaryTr: Several of the deceased are college students, according to local official Atul Bora, but they have not yet been publicly identified.
news.articleText: At least 24 killed after bus collides with truck in north-east India - Published At least 24 people have died and 11 others injured after a bus collided with a truck in Assam, north-east India. The accident happened near Kaziranga National Park, a Unesco World Heritage site, and the injured have been admitted to Jorhat Medical College and Hospital. Several of the deceased are college students, according to Assam's rural development minister Atul Bora, but they have not yet been publicly identified. Bora added that witnesses reported one of the vehicles may have been speeding when the crash took place, but "the exact reason will be known after [an investigation]". Assam chief minister Himanta Biswa Sarma wrote in a post on X that "the scale of this loss has shaken all of us". He adds: "Our foremost priority now is to make sure the injured receive the best possible medical care without delay." The bus was carrying passengers from Bokakhat and was headed towards Nagaon. Bokakhat is best known as the gateway to Kaziranga National Park, famous for its one-horned rhinoceroses. Nagaon is an important agricultural and commercial centre in central Assam, about 120km (74.5 miles) west of Bokakhat by road. Lurinjyoti Gogoi, chief of a regional opposition party, said road safety has long been a major concern in the state. "The government must take it up seriously," he said. Road accidents are responsible for thousands of deaths in India every year. In 2023, 172,000 people lost their lives on Indian roads, or 474 a day – roughly one every three minutes. The count increased to 183,382 deaths in 2025. Experts say the crisis is rooted not just in infrastructure but in human behaviour, enforcement gaps and systemic neglect. - Published21 April 2025
